result_members.capture_manifest.json: identity, population, repaired gates and claim boundary
result_members.sample_order.json: exact M1458 S40 cohort and order
result_members.layers.json: codebooks and one-time static weight address/bank/row-buffer map
result_members.token_source_groups.jsonl.zlib: ordered token rows with non-empty source groups only

token_group_encoding.support_hex: little-endian channel bitset; one bit per valid channel
token_group_encoding.sign_hex: subset of support; one means negative
token_group_encoding.nonunit_hex: subset of support; one means absolute code differs from unit_code
token_group_encoding.nonzero_codes_le_hex: signed little-endian codes, ordered by ascending set-bit channel
token_group_encoding.zero_token: retain token row with groups=[] to preserve order/commit/tail

quantization_boundary.tsbg_exact_scope: captured codeword and contributor stream only
quantization_boundary.formal_int8_result: blocked until a separately identified deterministic PTQ/QAT bridge and miter
